extDescription.message: Transcribes WhatsApp Web voice messages with a Whisper model running on your own computer.

box_transcribe_title.message: Transcribe this voice message with local Whisper

state_waiting_lock.message: Waiting for another transcription to finish…

err_empty_tab_reply.message: empty reply from the WhatsApp Web tab

err_host_no_reply.message: the local component is not responding

err_busy_transcribing.message: a transcription is running: try again when the queue is empty

err_wa_not_ready.message: WhatsApp Web is not ready yet

err_msg_not_loaded.message: message not loaded in WhatsApp Web: open the chat

err_not_voice.message: the message is not a voice message

err_model_missing.message: model $1 is not on disk: download it from the extension page

popup_chat.message: Transcribe voice messages in the open chat

popup_open_wa.message: Open a chat in WhatsApp Web in this tab.

popup_no_voices.message: No voice messages loaded in the open chat. Scroll up to load more.

popup_all_done.message: All loaded voice messages are already transcribed.

opt_tagline.message: Transcribes voice messages on your computer with Whisper: the audio never leaves your machine.

opt_searching.message: Looking for the local component on this computer…

opt_last_check.message: last check at $1, retrying every 3 seconds

opt_host_explain.message: The browser can't run Whisper by itself: it needs a small program on your computer. Download it, open it and click Next until it finishes. No administrator rights needed.

opt_autodetect.message: This page detects the installation automatically.

opt_smartscreen.message: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info and then Run anyway: the installer is not signed yet.

opt_err_forbidden.message: The local component is installed but doesn't recognise this extension (ID $1). Reinstall it from the latest version.

opt_err_exited.message: The local component closed right away: reinstall it. The error log is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\WhisperForWhatsAppWeb\whisper_host.log.

opt_models_intro.message: Models already downloaded with faster-whisper are found automatically. The bigger the model, the more accurate and the slower it is.

opt_pick_folder.message: Use a model from another folder…

opt_download_started.message: Download of $1 started: you can keep this page open or close it.

opt_pick_hint.message: Pick the folder in the Windows dialog (it may open behind the browser)…

opt_pick_invalid.message: $1 doesn't contain a faster-whisper model (model.bin and config.json are needed).

opt_ready.message: Open or reload WhatsApp Web: every voice message gets a Transcribe button, and incoming voice messages are transcribed automatically.

opt_auto_incoming.message: Automatically transcribe incoming voice messages, in any chat

opt_auto_visible.message: Also automatically transcribe older voice messages when they appear in the open chat

opt_prompt_ph.message: Names and terms Whisper should recognise, comma separated

opt_idle.message: Free memory after minutes of inactivity

opt_memory_note.message: While the local component is running the model stays in memory (large-v3: about 2 GB of RAM) and the next voice messages start right away. Transcriptions always run one at a time, even across Chrome and Edge.

opt_applied.message: Applied: takes effect from the next transcription.

opt_cache_note.message: They stay in this browser only, tied to the message: reopening the chat shows them again without transcribing.

opt_clear_confirm.message: Delete all saved transcriptions? They can't be recovered.

upd_text_ext.message: Only the extension is updated, then it reloads by itself.

upd_text_host.message: It installs without any window. A transcription in progress finishes first.

upd_text_both.message: First the local component, then the extension, which reloads at the end.

upd_text_manual.message: The installed component can't update itself yet: “Update” downloads the installer, to open as the first time. Then press “Update” again.

upd_p_waiting_queue.message: Waiting for the current transcription to finish…

upd_p_manual_host.message: Open the downloaded file and complete the installation, then press “Update” again.

upd_err_host_timeout.message: the updated component is not responding

upd_err_no_folder.message: no updatable extension folder: replace it by hand with the release zip

upd_none.message: Everything up to date: extension $1, local component $2.

upd_last_check.message: Last check: $1. It checks by itself once a day.
